review.rationale: CONFIRMED P1 stale protected-validation reuse in local.closeout_local, not merely an untested hypothesis. Independent tiny fixture first records a passed validation adapter running an actual Ruff command. Ignored .ruff.toml then changes to an incompatible required-version; an independent fresh Ruff command exits2. An unchanged result/base/files subject nevertheless reuses the old passed record with only one closeout validation dispatch, sets publication_eligible=True and creates an ordinary feature commit. No actual production protected gate or remote/main write was fabricated: the constrained adapter is explicitly labeled INDEPENDENT_SINGLE_REAL_RUFF_CHECK_NOT_PROTECTED_GATE. The real cache consumer and Git commit are exercised. Existing scoped CodingCommands controls independently reject changed tests/config/runner/declared dependency/selector and retain freshness for unrelated evidence; tracked-tree guards are useful but do not close ignored/toolchain/environment inputs. Bounded next repair: refuse unsafe reuse until a supported exact validation-input profile exists, or require fresh protected validation before commit. Bind executable/check selector, relevant inputs, toolchain/environment assumptions and declared exclusions; unknown/older profiles cannot silently qualify. Add ignored-config drift, fresh failure, unchanged reuse and irrelevant-file controls. Separately qualify HEAD-sensitive validation: integration validates working bytes before committing; tree equality alone does not prove HEAD/worktree-sensitive tests or external inputs equivalent. No universal filesystem read tracer, validator framework, gate weakening or retrospective receipt rewrite. Preserve source/review/task/grant boundaries; future repair needs explicit implementation scope.

review.rationale: Material cohort ownership evidence: task-scoped CodingCommands bundles and change_checks share existing fixed selectors and managed Commands; local closeout adds protected validation and feature-only authority; governed Integration independently owns destination tree/review/promotion. These are different claims, so do not merge them blindly into one validator or move orchestration into Runtime. Single-command evidence-name selection diverges from all-bundle/change-report reservation and has a distinct new P2 proposal rather than being hidden under this investigation. A small application-local receipt-allocation composition may be justified by those real consumers. Scripted review/validation fixtures prove wiring, not independent semantic review or model effectiveness. Existing large application/edit-size pressure and useful shared substrate remain open; no package split, new Agent or generic transaction system authorized.
